newsitem.title: UK: Waverley seeks liquidator for Monktonhall.
newsitem.headline: Waverley seeks liquidator for Monktonhall.

text.p: Waverley Mining Finance Plc said on Wednesday it was withdrawing all financial support from its wholly-owned subsidiary, Monktonhall Colliery, after floods rendered the project financially unviable.
Waverley said the board of Monktonhall had petitioned the Court of Session for the appointment of a provisional liquidator.
Waverley said the board of Monktonhall had taken extensive technical advice and concluded that coal production could not recommence until the water had been cleared.
"This loss of production and the likely cost of removing the water make reopening of the mine no longer financially viable," the company said.
Waverley had invested about 23 million stg by way of equity and loans in Monktonhall.
"Employees of Monktonhall will retain their "A" share shareholdings in Waverley," the company said.
